subject: [PATCH 12/16] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness, which exercises memory management functions against faults, pins, fork, mremap, and MADV_DONTNEED. The new threads simulate memory pressure by cycling MADV_PAGEOUT on a dedicated region and triggering compaction through /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory. These additions allow for more comprehensive testing of khugepaged's behavior under various stress scenarios.
